Coca Cola (KO) vs Microsoft (MSFT): on the same formula, their operating margins are 18.1 pts apart. What does that gap explain, and what doesn’t it?

Latest fiscal year, same formula
• Revenue — KO: $47.9B · MSFT: $331.8B
• Revenue growth — KO: +1.9% · MSFT: +17.8%
• Operating margin — KO: 28.7% · MSFT: 46.8%
• Net margin — KO: 27.3% · MSFT: 40.3%
• Free cash flow margin — KO: 11.0% · MSFT: 20.2%
• 4-year revenue growth (compound annual) — KO: 5.5% · MSFT: 13.7%

Different fiscal years: KO Dec 31, 2025 · MSFT Jun 30, 2026. The periods are not identical.
